story_type: tanker comes alongside a flooding sailboat far offshore
hook: Taking on water in 20-foot seas, 450 miles off Florida.
narration: Three sailors were taking on water in twenty foot seas.
Four hundred fifty miles out, a Coast Guard Hercules found their sailboat after dark.
A Hercules can circle for hours, but it cannot lift anyone out.
So a motor tanker, the Radiant Pride, came to them.
[short pause] Its crew brought the huge ship right alongside the little sailboat.
outcome: The tanker crew and the Hercules crew worked together and rescued all three sailors.

location_card.place: 450 miles east of Daytona Beach, Fla.

title: Sailboat flooding 450 miles off Florida
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City HC-130 Hercules aircrew and the crew of the motor tanker Radiant Pride rescued three people from a 44-foot sailboat taking on water in 20-foot seas, 450 miles east of Daytona Beach, Florida, on Feb. 1, 2026.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of the Air Station Elizabeth City HC-130 aircrew, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/994870/coast-guard-good-samaritans-rescue-3-people-450-miles-daytona-beach
